notes: move_pages with nodes=NULL queries residency; MPOL_MF_MOVE changes private process pages and returns per-page status. Existing mbind policy does not prohibit the diagnostic migration.

MEM_TRANS_RETIRED.LOAD_LATENCY selects instruction latencies >=128 cycles here. On this CPU, weight is cache-access latency and ins_lat is dispatch-to-completion instruction latency. Cache weights can be below 128. Neither conditional sample mean is an all-load average.
MEM_LOAD_RETIRED.L3_MISS counts retired load instructions with at least one uop missing L3. This is not a direct DRAM/CXL transaction count.
